note: Hand-written for the offline harness test. The text is original (no user data) and the three outputs are hand-written examples in the GradeResult shape, not responses captured from a model.
text:
I think the city should choose Option B, longer opening hours at public libraries.

First, many people work during the day and they can not visit the library before it close. For example, my sister is nurse and she finish work at 7 pm, so she never have a chance to borrow books. If the library open until 10 pm, people like her can use it.

Second, libraries are not only for books. They give free internet, quiet place to study and programs for children and newcomers. Longer hours means more people can take these services.

Bike lanes are also good idea, but in our city it is winter for five months, so they are not used so much. In conclusion, longer library hours will help more people in all seasons, so Option B is better choice.
